title: Retroactive Range Chmax
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq N\leq2\times10^5; 1\leq A_i\leq10^9\ (1\leq i\leq N); 1\leq Q\leq2\times10^5; In a type-1 operation, 1\leq l\leq r\leq N and 1\leq x\leq10^9.; In a type-2 operation, i is not greater than the number of operations given before, and 1\leq i.; In a type-2 operation, the i-th operation is of type 1.; In type-2 operations, the same i does not appear multiple times.; In a type-3 operation, 1\leq i\leq N.; All input values are integers.
